input.sparql:
SELECT ?p ?class ?ext ?tsid WHERE {
  ?z rdfs:label "Perimeter_ZN_2" ; a brick:HVAC_Zone .
  ?p brick:isPointOf ?z ; rdf:type ?class .
  OPTIONAL { ?p ref:hasExternalReference ?ext } .
  OPTIONAL { ?p ref:hasTimeseriesId ?tsid } .
FILTER(?class IN (brick:Zone_Air_Temperature_Sensor, brick:Zone_Air_Cooling_Temperature_Setpoint))
}
